description: The job decide reads the host environment itself before it decides (the host's plan job is merged into it, ADR-0050).

patches.find:
scriptPath: $(Pipeline.Workspace)/s/core/pipelines/azure-devops/scripts/provisioning/plan.sh
                  addSpnToEnvironment: false
                  useGlobalConfig: false
                  failOnStandardError: false
                  workingDirectory: $(Pipeline.Workspace)
                env:
                  SAF_ENV_NAME: ${{ parameters.hostEnvironment }}
patches.replace:
scriptPath: $(Pipeline.Workspace)/s/core/pipelines/azure-devops/scripts/provisioning/azure.sh
                  addSpnToEnvironment: false
                  useGlobalConfig: false
                  failOnStandardError: false
                  workingDirectory: $(Pipeline.Workspace)
                env:
                  SAF_ENV_NAME: ${{ parameters.hostEnvironment }}
